Central Works & Buildings Bureau 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Odisha · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/2/2018/079 
 Dated: 2026-03-31 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Pumping Station - Odisha Pkg-79" (water treatment), awarded to M/s
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in
 all respects on 2018-06-30 at a gross executed value of INR 35,86,00,000/- (Rupees 35.86 Crore Only).
 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract
 conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the
 undersigned. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Uma Sen. This certificate is issued for record and for
 submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Central Works & Buildings Bureau
